EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2873/2913/2930/2956 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), consistent with an alkyl-rich molecule. A distinct band at 3333 cm⁻¹ indicates an N–H stretch (GFQ-002), and the 957 cm⁻¹ feature aligns with N–H bending/wagging (GFQ-002). The pair at 1062 and 1133 cm⁻¹ is consistent with C–O/N–O stretching in an alkoxyamine. CC(C)CCON (an O–N–H alkoxyamine) matches these features better than candidates lacking N–H or having functionalities (e.g., Si–Cl, aromatic, P=O) that would produce strong bands not observed.
